title: Design System: Pot Plant Heaven Perth

display.purpose: Hero H1 only: condensed caps (wdth 72, 78 from 901px), nursery green.

headline.purpose: Section titles and side-sheet heads (2rem); condensed caps.

sheet-title.purpose: Plant name on the plant sheet's front tag; condensed caps.

quote.purpose: Stephen's words in the story band, quoted in full.

title.purpose: Plant names on catalogue tags, normal case; 1rem under 600px.

price.purpose: Every price: tags, size rows, order tabs, order total; tabular, wdth 70.

body.purpose: Running text; 1rem under 600px; descriptions capped at 65ch.

label.purpose: Fact terms, pot sizes, counts and field labels in soft ink.

shadows.name: shadow-tag
shadows.purpose: Catalogue tags at rest, empty states, sheet close button.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Tag hover/focus (with translateY(-4px)), menus, fly-to-order thumbnail.

shadows.name: staked-tag
shadows.purpose: filter on the hero search tag so the clipped stake casts; order lines use 0 6px 10px at 0.1.

shadows.name: punched-hole
shadows.purpose: The hole at the top of every tag face.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for every transition; no bounce.

motion.name: photo-morph
motion.purpose: Tag photo morphs into the plant sheet photo and back on close.

motion.name: fly-to-order
motion.value: 620ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), 64px thumbnail arcing to the Order tag, then bump scale 1.07 over 400ms
motion.purpose: Shows where an added plant went; reduced motion keeps only the bump.

motion.name: tag-enter
motion.value: 500ms ease-out, translateY(12px) + fade, stagger 45ms x min(i, 8)
motion.purpose: New tags entering the bed after a filter or 'Show more'.

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.value: 400ms ease-out; centred sheets rise 16px, side sheets slide 32px from the right
motion.purpose: Plant, order and helper sheets opening.

motion.name: drop
motion.purpose: Contact and compact menus, hedge sub-chips (300ms).

narrative.overview:
Every plant is its own white plastic stake label: the catalogue card, the plant sheet and the order line are all tags. They hang on a pale leaf-white ground, the way labels look on a bench in the morning. The system is calm on purpose. One deep nursery green does the speaking, one process yellow marks money, and everything else is white tag plastic, potting-soil ink and hairline rules. Room to breathe replaces the earlier drenched-green treatment, so the plants and their prices carry the page.

The tag is a physical object with fixed anatomy: rounded shoulders, a punched hole at the top centre, the plant photo, a normal-case name, an italic botanical line, light icons, and a full-width yellow price flash at the foot. Stakes (the pointed spike) appear only where a tag is shown driven into something: the 3D tag in the pot, the hero search tag and the order lines. Grid tags hang flat without tilt or stake and lift on soft shadows.

Motion is quick and physical. It uses exponential ease-out with no bounce, and nothing is hidden until animated. A tag's photo morphs into the plant sheet, an added plant flies into the Order tag, and new tags rise in a short stagger. With reduced motion, only crossfades and state changes remain.
keyCharacteristics: Pale leaf-white ground; white tags; deep green as the single accent.
Yellow means money, and nothing else is yellow.
One variable family (Archivo) carries everything, with the width axis as its main voice: condensed caps for headlines, normal-case names on tags.
Soft, low shadows; hairline rules for structure; no tilt.
Green owns a whole ground only in the story band; the footer sits on the deepest green.

rules.name: The Money Is Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow appears only where a price or the act of ordering is. If a yellow surface carries no price and commits nothing, it is wrong.

rules.name: The One Green Ground Rule
rules.body: Green fills a whole band once, in the story. The footer uses the deepest green. Every other section sits on leaf-white or tag-white.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from width and weight in one family. Never add a second typeface; reach for `wdth` 70–88 instead.

rules.name: The Normal-Case Name Rule
rules.body: Catalogue tag names are normal case so long plant names stay readable. Condensed caps are reserved for headlines, the plant-sheet title and the 3D tag.

rules.name: The Hanging Tag Rule
rules.body: Tags hang; they don't float. Shadows stay soft and low, lift is 4px at most, and nothing rotates.

dos: Do put every price on yellow: the tag flash band, the order-line tab, the selected size row.
Do keep the punched hole on every tag face, and draw stakes only on the 3D tag, the search tag and order lines.
Do use the `edge` token for full-bleed bands so their content shares the column's left edge.
Do animate with the exponential ease-out `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` and no bounce, and keep every animated element visible without JS.
Do keep tap targets at 44px or more and full buttons at 48px.
Do use 1px hairlines (`hairline`, `hairline-strong`) to divide facts, steps, FAQ rows and size rows.
donts: Don't use yellow for anything that is not money or the order action. That includes decorative fills, highlights and section grounds.
Don't fill a section ground with green other than the story band, or with shade-house deep other than the footer.
Don't tilt grid tags, give them stakes, or use hard offset shadows.
Don't add a second typeface. Use Archivo's width axis instead.
Don't set catalogue tag names in caps.
Don't put small tracked-caps labels above headings. The only tracked caps are the wordmark's "PERTH" and the brand imprint printed on a tag face.
Don't use glyph or emoji icons. Every icon comes from the one drawn SVG family (24px grid, 1.75 stroke, round joins).
Don't float anything over the plants: no popups and no fixed widgets. The helper opens only as a side sheet when asked.
